parameters.name: DataKeyName
parameters.description: The name of the managed data key (DK). This parameter is required.

parameters.name: DataKeyVersionId
parameters.description: The version number of the managed data key (DK). This parameter is optional. If you set this parameter to a specific version number, the plaintext of the specified version of the managed data key (DK) is returned.

parameters.name: UseLatest
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to use the latest version of the managed data key (DK) when no version number is provided. Valid values:

- true: Returns the latest version of the managed data key (DK).
- false: Returns the first version of the managed data key (DK).

Default value: false.
